brief: Cuts sections out of a text by position: reads a section or a range, lists what lies outside, and removes sections.
detail: Build one with new stzStringSections("text"). A section is a pair of positions, start and end, both included; a range is a start and a length. Positions count from 1 in characters, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji are cut by letter. The readers (Section, Range, Sections, AntiSections) raise for positions outside the text, while the removals clip them. The in-place removals have passive twins that return the text (SectionRemoved, SectionsRemoved, RangeRemoved). Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first in-place removal empties it. A length of 0 and SectionBetween for close positions go wrong, and RemoveSections needs its pairs in ascending order; see the warnings.
